title: A paid multi run records its plan, done runs and spend where a monitor can read them
goal: bench_multi.progress(manifest, lines, bare, max_usd) gives a run's planned runs per arm, done runs per arm, spend_usd and max_usd, and multi run keeps DIR/progress.json written from it, with its pid and start time, from before its first paid call to its end

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_multi as b
m={'agents':[{'n':1},{'n':2},{'n':3}]};L=[{'arm':'kb','cost':1.5},{'arm':'kb','cost':1.5},{'arm':'bare','cost':0.5}]
f=getattr(b,'progress',None)
if f is None:print('bench_multi has no progress function');sys.exit(1)
p=f(m,L,bare=True,max_usd=10.0);print(p)
sys.exit(0 if p['planned']=={'kb':3,'bare':3} and p['done']=={'kb':2,'bare':1} and abs(p['spend_usd']-3.5)<1e-9 and p['max_usd']==10.0 else 1)
